name: 2207-widebatchdecode-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: dense decoder (LlamaForCausalLM), 32 layers, 32 query and 32 KV heads (MHA), head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, vocab 32000, context window 4096, float16, 6.7B params (~13.5 GB).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup 20%, bounded at 6400 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, 128 prompt tokens and 256 output tokens per request, both pinned exactly (min == max == nominal). Sampling: temperature 0.7, top_p 0.9, top_k 50, ignore_eos true, penalties left neutral; request_format plain.
purpose: A 7B chat assistant generating short replies from brief prompts for 128 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments for this operating point.
#
# vLLM 0.2.6-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, not a
# warning. Do not add keys from a later vLLM (prefix caching, chunked prefill, kv-cache-dtype,
# num-gpu-blocks-override and speculative decoding do not exist at this version).
#
# THIS FILE IS READ LINE BY LINE: `key: value` only, and a value beginning `{` or `[` is parsed
# as JSON. An indented YAML block is skipped and never reaches AsyncEngineArgs.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
